about: Commands Agent Drive may use in experiments on this repository. Drive's planner picks a metric and checks by name; it cannot run anything not listed here.

metrics.name: rounds per task
metrics.about: Model rounds the coding agent needs per task to answer 8 read-only questions about this repo (bench/agent-tasks.json) with the configured provider model, twice each: a 10%-trimmed mean, with wrong answers scored as 20 rounds. Captures how efficiently the agent searches and reads. Also reports correctness, tool calls, re-reads and input tokens. Baseline on qwen3.8-27b at 4d20b9f: 4.07 (16/16 correct).
